method.label_selection: highest-contributing dimension per family region, explicit linked labels only
method.part_of: component maps to containing entity; no component counted independently
method.same_family: only distant tree regions may repeat
method.fdr: BH over train-selected layout keys, evaluated on dev

limitations: Qwen labels and family masks are provisional, not object segmentation.
Two separated tree regions may still be one physical tree.
Fine compositions are descriptive; their p/q values were not separately tested.
VLM evidence may overlap later test images; sealed test activations were not accessed.
